name: indxr-video
description: Standalone workspace (ADR-089: outside the Turborepo build graph, own install, never deploys) for INDXR marketing export-demos (export-demos/). The home-clip demo VIDEO is now a real Playwright screen recording — tests/playwright/capture/home-clip-video.spec.ts (+ playwright.homeclip.config.ts) records recordings/home-clip{,-dark}.webm, converted with ffmpeg to apps/marketing/public/video/home-clip-{light,dark}.mp4. The former Remotion still+cursor+zoom composition (HomeClip) was removed in favour of the real recording.
